questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select No Error.**

He explained that the pillars of tribalism (1)/ that humans relied on for security would always (2)/ fill any significant cultural or social change. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is** 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-
__
 
• The error is in **part 3**.
 
• It should be** “encounter” **instead of **“fill”**.
 
• **Encounter** means **to unexpectedly be faced with or experience.**
 
 
• **For Example - **We have **encountered** one small problem.
 
 
 
• **Fill***(verb)* - cause (space or container) to become full or almost full.
 
 
• **For Example** - I **filled **the bottle with water.
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about the pillars of tribalism that humans depend upon **would always experience unexpected cultural or social changes.**
 
• **Cultural**: relating to the habits, traditions, and beliefs of society:
 
 
• **Example:** *Australia has its own **cultural **identity, which is very different from that of Britain.*
 
 
 
• That is why the correct word here is **encounter**.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is ***He explained that the pillars of tribalism that humans relied on for security would always** encounter** any significant cultural or social change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e549cb45ac78aca065082aa5a940b1d6506603cfff2fd1300a22049ad93dc6.png] *

 
• **Culture:** the way of life, especially the general customs and beliefs, of a particular group of people at a particular time

 
 
• **Example*****: **She's studying the modern Japanese language and **culture**.*
 
 
 
• *Here, we need an adjective to qualify 'change'. *

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **'Or'** is a **coordinating conjunction**. A conjunction **joins words phrases or clause that should be same in form and function.**
 
• Here, **'social' **is an adjective that is qualifying the noun** 'change'**.

P: There was once a time when people looked forward to the lazy evenings.

Q: They had a simple choice of programmes on Doordarshan

R: It was entirely up to them to watch or not to watch the selected presentation

S: Today, the satellite and Cable Television have stormed the media world of information and entertainment.
questions.solution:
First Sentence- Sentence P talks about a time from past when people looked forward to lazy evenings. This shows that the paragraph is more of a sort of comparison and therefore introduces the subject to the readers.

Second Sentence- Sentence Q begins with 'they' which shows that the subject (addressing people) from the previous sentence must be the subject here as well, that means it is a continuation of the previous sentence.

Third Sentence- Sentence Q had already explained that the choice of programmes was limited on doordarshan back then. Sentence R in next in sequence as it talks about how it was entirely up to people to watch or not to watch the selected presentation given by doordarshan.

Fourth Sentence- Sentence S compares and contrasts the time back then with the time today in terms of satellite and cable television thereby concluding the discussion.

Fourth Sentence- Sentence S conclude the story of Siddhartha by explaining his last few moments at his palace.
